setup_only_failures: Go refused overlays beneath GOMODCACHE; the join command did not execute.

The private module source copy inherited read-only permissions; overwrite was refused and the command using the absent modfile did not execute. Only the private copy tea.go permissions were corrected.
interpretation: This paired probe strongly supports a renderer stop/join race hypothesis; it does not provide an exact runtime interleaving trace.

ClearScreen was added only in a private test overlay, and the stop/join patch was applied only to a private dependency source copy. Production callbacks, go.mod, and module-cache sources were untouched.
Join-only was not tested. No application fix or dependency shipping fix is qualified.
